text: nirujjhati dhammasaññā ca virajjati se āyatane veditabbe 1 . ko nu kho imassa bhagavatā #1 ma. yu. itisaddo atthi . saṅkhittena uddesassa uddiṭṭhassa vitthārena atthaṃ avibhattassa vitthārena atthaṃ vibhajeyyāti . tesaṃ no bhante amhākaṃ etadahosi ayaṃ kho āyasmā ānando satthu ceva saṃvaṇṇito sambhāvito ca viññūnaṃ sabrahmacārīnaṃ pahoti cāyasmā ānando imassa bhagavatā saṅkhittena uddesassa uddiṭṭhassa vitthārena atthaṃ avibhattassa vitthārena atthaṃ vibhajituṃ yannūna mayaṃ yenāyasmā ānando tenupasaṅkameyyāma upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ
